items.title: Crescent Capital Group Closes Largest Fund in Firm’s History with Fourth U.S. Direct Lending Fund, Raising $10.8 Billion in Investable Capital
items.summary: Crescent Capital Group LP (“Crescent”), one of the leading alternative credit investment firms, announced today the successful final close of its fourth U.S. direct lending fund, Crescent Direct Lending Fund IV (“CDL Fund IV”), raising $10.8 billion in investable capital, including targeted leverage and separately managed accounts investing alongside the fund. Following the close, Crescent now manages more than $50 billion in assets under management globally.

items.title: 35 Years of Disciplined Investing in Private Credit
items.summary: April 2026 – 35 years. Multiple cycles. One consistent approach to private credit. Our latest Q&A, “35 Years of Disciplined Investing in Private Credit,” features Crescent President Chris Wright and Managing Director Chris Wang on what today’s market demands—and why experience is increasingly important to today’s market.

items.title: CLO Equity in a Diversified Portfolio
items.summary: April 2026 – Managing Directors Kimberly Frazier & Nilesh Mandhare, along with Charlie Youngblood, Senior Vice President & Product Specialist, examine the role CLO Equity can play as a differentiated income stream alongside other asset classes.

items.title: Crescent Capital Appointed by U.K. Pension Fund Nest for £450 Million U.S. Direct Lending Mandate
items.summary: Crescent Capital Group LP, one of the leading alternative credit investment firms, announced today that it has been appointed by Nest, the largest U.K. workplace pension scheme by number of members, to manage a new open-ended U.S. direct lending mandate.

items.title: Energy Shock Reprices Rates: March 2026
items.summary: March 2026 – Crescent Head of Tradable Credit John Fekete examines how the recently renewed link between oil prices and interest rates is reshaping the macro outlook for 2026

items.title: Crescent Private Credit Insights: January 2026
items.summary: January 2026 – In the latest edition of our Private Credit Insights series, Crescent President Chris Wright and Managing Director Chris Wang describe the current state of the U.S. private credit market, and their view of its resilience and relevance going deeper into 2026.

items.title: Crescent Closes $3.2 Billion Private Credit Continuation Vehicle
items.summary: Crescent Capital Group LP, one of the leading alternative credit investment firms, and Pantheon, one of the leading global private markets investors, today announced the closing of Crescent Credit Solutions VII CV (“CCS VII CV”), a $3.2 billion private credit continuation vehicle. CCS VII CV was established to acquire a diversified portfolio of performing sponsor-backed loans and securities and other equity interests from Crescent Mezzanine Partners VII, a 2016-vintage fund.

items.title: The Big Picture: Forget the Slowdown – Why the Economy Might Accelerate in 2026
items.summary: December 2025 – John Fekete (Head of Tradeable Credit at Crescent) and Dec Mullarkey, CFA (Managing Director, Investment Strategy & Asset Allocation at SLC Management) break down the forces shaping the macro landscape – from shifting rate policy, stubborn inflation and fiscal tailwinds to credit-market strength, AI-driven productivity, and global trends.

items.title: CLO Market Insights: September 2025
items.summary: September 2025 – In our latest CLO Market Insights report, Crescent Vice President James Guido & Managing Director Wayne Hosang share updated perspectives on the asset class, including where we’re seeing value and how investors can access this market to fit their varied needs.
